title: Crow Caw
author: Jofae
description: A single short crow caw (this was probably the best out of all I got) I got off a crow flying from its tree. Don't they sound like they're laughing? :D Enjoy! Also, be sure to follow me for more sound effects to come. P.S. I request that all my sound effects only be used for clean, appropriate media and projects. Thanks!
